Backend Processing

Vendor details are retrieved from the FastAPI backend and stored in PostgreSQL.

  • Retrieve vendor information by Vendor ID.
  • Retrieve uploaded documents.
  • Retrieve audit information.
  • Retrieve approval and vendor status.
  • Return complete vendor details to Angular.

Procurement Integration

Only vendors whose Approval Status is Approved and whose Vendor Status is Active can be selected during Procurement.
